title: Research: bounded R420 phase-B block 4 resynthesis (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

This finite circuit contribution replaces PR543's historical R420 phase-B block 4 at frame 546 (`B[313:371]`) with a 51-XOR circuit, down from 58. Regenerating the complete word and required literal reverse cleanup changes the total from 26,916 to 26,902 scalar ADDs. Seven downstream register routes change and are regenerated. No helper, source access, COPY, retained total, or recursive child is removed.

No new κ is claimed. The current selected construction and selected κ remain unchanged; R420 is a historical alternative below the current selected bit supplier.

## Search scope

The fixed randomized pivoted-LU sampler from the retained R420 generator was run for 20,000 draws on this block (seed 28 under its existing `7 * block_index` rule). The fixed budget produced the included candidate. This does not establish optimality and excludes no circuit outside that sampler.

## Reproduction and checks

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-block4-resynthesis/verify.py
```

Expected summary:

```text
PASS_R420_BLOCK4_RESYNTHESIS baseline=58 candidate=51 local_ADDs=26916->26902 routes_changed=7
CANDIDATE_SHA256 fed96ef0358166b0b81afdb09e03001ec3979619a78c777089b62fd350382ffa
```

The verifier reruns the search and checks all 660 symbolic columns, the exact word and cleanup, H1-H5 and interface, plus nine negative and one positive mutation control. The full adapted R420 pipeline was also run, including native five-, nine-, and eleven-stage cohort checks, both hosted pricing paths, and R480/R489 controls. See `VALIDATION.json` for exact receipts, source pins, tool versions, and limits. That full hosted run used a temporary copy of the upstream verifier with the same two anchored original-word comparison steps adapted as documented; the packaged `hosted.py` renderer was checked separately.

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`.

The work credits the PR543/370/493 R420 lineage, PR688 replay structure, PR510/493 hosted pricing, PR535/531 historical assembly receipts, and the distinct concurrent R420 block submissions listed in the package. Prepared for @1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human review is claimed.
